title: A Cape Cod hotel is one of the most haunted stays in America, according to Frommer's
excerpt: A Cape Cod waterfront hotel is one of the most haunted stays in the United States, according to Frommer's.
content:
New England Travel

It's a restored 1875 sea captain's home.

Travelers seeking a spooky stay this season should check into a 19th-century waterfront hotel on Cape Cod, according to Frommer’s.

The travel publication posted a list of America’s most haunted hotels and included the Orleans Waterfront Inn in Orleans. The 1875 bed & breakfast on the Lower Cape, a restored sea captain’s home on Orleans Cove, has 11 rooms, a cozy tavern, waterfront dining room, and outdoor deck.

Here is what Frommer’s wrote, in part, about the family-run hotel:

According to the innkeepers, the inn is haunted by more than one paranormal presence. The feistiest spirit, Hannah, is said to have lived and worked in the inn when it housed a brothel in the early 19th century. Rumor has it she may have been murdered on the job. Guests and employees report mysteriously extinguished candles and flickering lights. Guests who stay in Room 4, a lovely waterfront suite, have even reported conversing with Hannah via flashlight. Position the flashlight in the bathroom and ask yes or no questions. If the answer is yes, Hannah turns the flashlight off and then on again.

Visitors can read more ghost stories on the inn’s website, including how The Atlantic Paranormal Society (TAPS) once visited for the SyFy show “Ghost Hunters.”
